ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Extremely low white-to-black ratio; ventral surface is predominantly composed of low-intensity dark pixels with isolated mid-intensity grey clusters.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant dark pigmentation field. Discrete mid-intensity geometric blobs identified: one large circular cluster in the upper-right distal quadrant and three overlapping circular patches in the lower-left proximal quadrant.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Acute V-shaped indentation; interior angle approximately 30-35 degrees with significant depth relative to the fluke width.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Continuous irregular serration along the trailing edge; higher amplitude peaks are clustered near the median notch and the right distal tip.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature on leading edges; trailing edges follow an upward sweep with localized concavity near the median notch transitioning to straight segments towards the tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Multiple circular and oval-shaped high-contrast pixel clusters (light grey on dark background) distributed asymmetrically; prominent on the right lobe distal area and left lobe mid-proximal area.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two distinct horizontal linear pixel disruptions identified: one short light streak on the upper-left lobe and one near the upper-right edge of the median notch.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Widespread circular scarring consistent with bio-fouling or parasitic attachment across the ventral surface; no evidence of major fluke amputations or traumatic tissue loss.
